description: This file serves as a utility entry point to run a FastAPI application with a consistent import path. It sets up the environment for Uvicorn server to run the application located at 'src.api.main:app'. It also ensures the project root is on sys.path to allow proper module importation regardless of current working directory.

methods.name: None _ensure_project_root_on_path()
methods.description: Ensures that the project root directory is added to sys.path so that the 'src' package can be imported correctly, even when the script is run from different working directories.

methods.name: None main()
methods.description: Launches the Uvicorn server with configuration options for host, port, reload, workers, and log level based on environment variables, targeting the FastAPI app at 'src.api.main:app'.
